1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""Atomic HTTP/3-to-HTTP/1.1 bridge with a per-origin audit ledger.
     3	
     4	Decoded HTTP/3 request events (QUIC reliability and QPACK already done) are
     5	buffered per stream.  On FIN the complete message is validated against this
     6	deployment's rules and, only when every rule holds, serialized as canonical
     7	HTTP/1.1 bytes and appended to the routed origin's pipeline, so each pipeline
     8	follows FIN order.  RESET cancels a stream, a missing terminal event leaves it
     9	incomplete, and a rejected stream contributes no bytes at all.
    10	
    11	Every string inside a field pair is an octet string: one Latin-1 code point per
    12	octet (U+0000..U+00FF).  The same convention applies to the ledger.  Nothing
    13	here opens a socket, spawns a process, contacts an origin, or writes a file.
    14	"""
    15	
    16	import ipaddress
    17	import json
    18	import sys
    19	
    20	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    21	# Deployment limits and grammars
    22	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    23	
    24	MAX_CONTENT = 65536   # concatenated DATA octets per stream
    25	MAX_SECTION = 8192    # uncompressed size of a single HEADERS section
    26	
    27	HEADERS = 0           # frame markers used by the per-stream buffers
    28	DATA = 1
    29	
    30	METHODS = frozenset((b"GET", b"HEAD", b"POST", b"PUT",
    31	                     b"PATCH", b"DELETE", b"OPTIONS"))
    32	SCHEMES = frozenset((b"http", b"https"))
    33	DEFAULT_PORTS = {b"http": 80, b"https": 443}
    34	
    35	# Connection/framing concerns plus deployment exclusions; rejected even empty.
    36	PROHIBITED_FIELDS = frozenset((
    37	    b"connection", b"proxy-connection", b"keep-alive", b"transfer-encoding",
    38	    b"upgrade", b"http2-settings", b"trailer"))
    39	
    40	# Regular initial fields that may repeat without merging.
    41	LIST_FIELDS = frozenset((
    42	    b"accept", b"accept-encoding", b"cache-control", b"if-match",
    43	    b"if-none-match", b"pragma", b"vary"))
    44	
    45	PSEUDO_HEADERS = frozenset((b":method", b":scheme", b":authority", b":path"))
    46	
    47	# Octets permitted in a regular field name (lower-case token grammar only).
    48	_NAME_ALLOWED = b"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789!#$%&'*+-.^_`|~"
    49	
    50	# Octets permitted anywhere in a field value.  SP and HTAB are interior-only
    51	# and are refused at the edges separately.
    52	_VALUE_ALLOWED = bytes([0x09, 0x20] + list(range(0x21, 0x7F))
    53	                       + list(range(0x80, 0x100)))
    54	
    55	# Octets permitted in an origin-form path; '%' is validated as an escape.
    56	_PATH_ALLOWED = (b"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
    57	                 b"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-._~!$&'()*+,;=:@/?%")
    58	
    59	_DIGITS = b"0123456789"
    60	_HEX = frozenset(b"0123456789abcdefABCDEF")
    61	_X_LIST = b"x-list-"
    62	_X_AUDIT = b"x-audit-"
    63	
    64	
    65	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    66	# Octet helpers
    67	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    68	
    69	def octets(text):
    70	    """Return the octet string for a Latin-1 code-point string, else None."""
    71	    if isinstance(text, str):
    72	        try:
    73	            return text.encode("latin-1")
    74	        except UnicodeEncodeError:
    75	            return None
    76	    return None
    77	
    78	
    79	def field_name_ok(name):
    80	    """Non-empty lower-case token."""
    81	    return bool(name) and not name.translate(None, _NAME_ALLOWED)
    82	
    83	
    84	def field_value_ok(value):
    85	    """Field-value octet rule: SP/HTAB only in the interior."""
    86	    if not value:
    87	        return True
    88	    for edge in (value[0], value[-1]):
    89	        if not (0x21 <= edge <= 0x7E or edge >= 0x80):
    90	            return False
    91	    return not value.translate(None, _VALUE_ALLOWED)
    92	
    93	
    94	def path_ok(path, method):
    95	    """'*' for OPTIONS, else an origin-form target preserved exactly."""
    96	    if path == b"*":
    97	        return method == b"OPTIONS"
    98	    if not path or path[0] != 0x2F or path[1:2] == b"/":
    99	        return False
   100	    if path.translate(None, _PATH_ALLOWED):
   101	        return False
   102	    pos = path.find(b"%")
   103	    while pos != -1:
   104	        if (pos + 3 > len(path) or path[pos + 1] not in _HEX
   105	                or path[pos + 2] not in _HEX):
   106	            return False
   107	        pos = path.find(b"%", pos + 1)
   108	    return True
   109	
   110	
   111	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   112	# Authority grammar, normalization and routing identity
   113	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   114	
   115	def _alphanum(byte):
   116	    return (0x30 <= byte <= 0x39 or 0x41 <= byte <= 0x5A
   117	            or 0x61 <= byte <= 0x7A)
   118	
   119	
   120	def parse_port(text):
   121	    """Port of 1..5 ASCII decimal digits denoting 1..65535, else None."""
   122	    if not 1 <= len(text) <= 5:
   123	        return None
   124	    if text.translate(None, _DIGITS):
   125	        return None
   126	    value = int(text)
   127	    if 1 <= value <= 65535:
   128	        return value
   129	    return None
   130	
   131	
   132	def canonical_host(host):
   133	    """Canonicalize a DNS name or IPv4 literal; None when invalid."""
   134	    if not 1 <= len(host) <= 253:
   135	        return None
   136	    labels = host.split(b".")
   137	    # A name of exactly four all-digit labels must be an IPv4 literal.
   138	    if len(labels) == 4 and all(
   139	            label and not label.translate(None, _DIGITS) for label in labels):
   140	        parts = []
   141	        for label in labels:
   142	            if len(label) > 1 and label[0] == 0x30:
   143	                return None            # leading zero
   144	            value = int(label)
   145	            if value > 255:
   146	                return None
   147	            parts.append(b"%d" % value)
   148	        return b".".join(parts)
   149	    for label in labels:
   150	        if not 1 <= len(label) <= 63:
   151	            return None
   152	        if not (_alphanum(label[0]) and _alphanum(label[-1])):
   153	            return None
   154	        for byte in label:
   155	            if not (_alphanum(byte) or byte == 0x2D):
   156	                return None
   157	    return host.lower()
   158	
   159	
   160	def canonical_authority(authority, scheme):
   161	    """Return the canonical authority octets, or None when invalid."""
   162	    if not authority:
   163	        return None
   164	    port = None
   165	    if authority[0] == 0x5B:                      # '['
   166	        end = authority.find(b"]")
   167	        if end == -1:
   168	            return None
   169	        host = authority[1:end]
   170	        rest = authority[end + 1:]
   171	        if rest:
   172	            if rest[0] != 0x3A:                   # ':'
   173	                return None
   174	            port = parse_port(rest[1:])
   175	            if port is None:
   176	                return None
   177	        if b"%" in host:                          # no zone identifier
   178	            return None
   179	        try:
   180	            address = ipaddress.IPv6Address(host.decode("ascii"))
   181	        except ValueError:
   182	            return None
   183	        canonical = b"[" + address.compressed.encode("ascii") + b"]"
   184	    else:
   185	        if b":" in authority:
   186	            host, _, port_text = authority.partition(b":")
   187	            port = parse_port(port_text)
   188	            if port is None:
   189	                return None
   190	        else:
   191	            host = authority
   192	        canonical = canonical_host(host)
   193	        if canonical is None:
   194	            return None
   195	    if port is not None and port != DEFAULT_PORTS[scheme]:
   196	        canonical += b":%d" % port
   197	    return canonical
   198	
   199	
   200	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   201	# Per-stream validation and canonical HTTP/1.1 serialization
   202	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   203	
   204	def finalize(frames, routes):
   205	    """Validate one FIN-terminated stream.
   206	
   207	    Returns (request_bytes, cache_key, origin_label) on success and None when
   208	    any rule fails.  ``frames`` holds (HEADERS, fields) / (DATA, bytes) pairs
   209	    with unknown frames already dropped.
   210	    """
   211	    # ---- frame structure: one HEADERS, DATA*, optional trailing HEADERS ----
   212	    if not frames or frames[0][0] != HEADERS:
   213	        return None
   214	    initial = frames[0][1]
   215	    index = 1
   216	    total = len(frames)
   217	    chunks = []
   218	    while index < total and frames[index][0] == DATA:
   219	        chunks.append(frames[index][1])
   220	        index += 1
   221	    trailing = None
   222	    if index < total:
   223	        if frames[index][0] != HEADERS or index + 1 != total:
   224	            return None
   225	        trailing = frames[index][1]
   226	    content = b"".join(chunks)
   227	    if len(content) > MAX_CONTENT:
   228	        return None
   229	
   230	    # ---- initial HEADERS: pseudo-headers first, then regular fields ----
   231	    pseudo = {}
   232	    regular = []
   233	    size = 0
   234	    for pair in initial:
   235	        if not isinstance(pair, (list, tuple)) or len(pair) != 2:
   236	            return None
   237	        name = octets(pair[0])
   238	        value = octets(pair[1])
   239	        if name is None or value is None:
   240	            return None
   241	        size += len(name) + len(value) + 32
   242	        if name[0:1] == b":":
   243	            if regular:
   244	                return None                      # pseudo after regular field
   245	            if name not in PSEUDO_HEADERS or name in pseudo:
   246	                return None
   247	            if not field_value_ok(value):
   248	                return None
   249	            pseudo[name] = value
   250	        else:
   251	            if not field_name_ok(name) or not field_value_ok(value):
   252	                return None
   253	            regular.append((name, value))
   254	    if size > MAX_SECTION:
   255	        return None
   256	
   257	    method = pseudo.get(b":method")
   258	    scheme = pseudo.get(b":scheme")
   259	    path = pseudo.get(b":path")
   260	    authority = pseudo.get(b":authority")
   261	    if method is None or scheme is None or path is None:
   262	        return None
   263	    if method not in METHODS or scheme not in SCHEMES:
   264	        return None
   265	    if not path_ok(path, method):
   266	        return None
   267	
   268	    # ---- regular field policy: duplicates, exclusions, content-length ----
   269	    seen = set()
   270	    length_lines = []
   271	    cookies = []
   272	    host_value = None
   273	    te_seen = False
   274	    for name, value in regular:
   275	        if name in PROHIBITED_FIELDS:
   276	            return None
   277	        if name == b"host":
   278	            if host_value is not None:
   279	                return None                      # repeated host
   280	            host_value = value
   281	        elif name == b"te":
   282	            if te_seen:
   283	                return None
   284	            te_seen = True
   285	            if value != b"trailers":
   286	                return None
   287	        elif name == b"content-length":
   288	            length_lines.append(value)
   289	        elif name == b"cookie":
   290	            cookies.append(value)
   291	        elif (name in LIST_FIELDS
   292	              or (len(name) > len(_X_LIST) and name.startswith(_X_LIST))):
   293	            continue                             # repeatable list field
   294	        elif name in seen:
   295	            return None                          # repeated singleton
   296	        else:
   297	            seen.add(name)
   298	
   299	    # Content-Length: comma-separated members, all one integer, equal to body.
   300	    if length_lines:
   301	        expected = b"%d" % len(content)
   302	        reference = None
   303	        for line in length_lines:
   304	            for member in line.split(b","):
   305	                item = member.strip(b" \t")
   306	                if not item or item.translate(None, _DIGITS):
   307	                    return None
   308	                trimmed = item.lstrip(b"0") or b"0"
   309	                if reference is None:
   310	                    reference = trimmed
   311	                elif reference != trimmed:
   312	                    return None
   313	        if reference != expected:
   314	            return None
   315	
   316	    # ---- request authority: :authority with an exactly matching host ----
   317	    if authority is not None and host_value is not None:
   318	        if authority != host_value:
   319	            return None
   320	        target = authority
   321	    elif authority is not None:
   322	        target = authority
   323	    elif host_value is not None:
   324	        target = host_value
   325	    else:
   326	        return None
   327	    if not target:
   328	        return None
   329	    canonical = canonical_authority(target, scheme)
   330	    if canonical is None:
   331	        return None
   332	    origin = routes.get((scheme + b"://" + canonical).decode("latin-1"))
   333	    if origin is None:
   334	        return None
   335	
   336	    # ---- trailing HEADERS: repeatable x-audit-* list fields only ----
   337	    trailer_pairs = []
   338	    if trailing is not None:
   339	        size = 0
   340	        for pair in trailing:
   341	            if not isinstance(pair, (list, tuple)) or len(pair) != 2:
   342	                return None
   343	            name = octets(pair[0])
   344	            value = octets(pair[1])
   345	            if name is None or value is None:
   346	                return None
   347	            size += len(name) + len(value) + 32
   348	            if (len(name) <= len(_X_AUDIT) or not name.startswith(_X_AUDIT)
   349	                    or not field_name_ok(name)):
   350	                return None
   351	            if not field_value_ok(value):
   352	                return None
   353	            trailer_pairs.append((name, value))
   354	        if size > MAX_SECTION:
   355	            return None
   356	
   357	    # ---- canonical HTTP/1.1 bytes ----
   358	    request = bytearray()
   359	    request += method
   360	    request += b" "
   361	    request += path
   362	    request += b" HTTP/1.1\r\n"
   363	    request += b"host: "
   364	    request += canonical
   365	    request += b"\r\n"
   366	    cookie_blob = b"; ".join(cookies)
   367	    cookie_placed = not cookies
   368	    for name, value in regular:
   369	        if name == b"cookie":
   370	            if not cookie_placed:                # one joined line, first spot
   371	                cookie_placed = True
   372	                request += b"cookie: "
   373	                request += cookie_blob
   374	                request += b"\r\n"
   375	        elif name == b"host" or name == b"content-length" or name == b"te":
   376	            continue                             # consumed by the bridge
   377	        else:
   378	            request += name
   379	            request += b": "
   380	            request += value
   381	            request += b"\r\n"
   382	    if trailing is None:
   383	        request += b"content-length: %d\r\n\r\n" % len(content)
   384	        request += content
   385	    else:
   386	        request += b"transfer-encoding: chunked\r\n"
   387	        if trailer_pairs:
   388	            announced = []
   389	            announced_seen = set()
   390	            for name, _value in trailer_pairs:
   391	                if name not in announced_seen:
   392	                    announced_seen.add(name)
   393	                    announced.append(name)
   394	            request += b"trailer: "
   395	            request += b", ".join(announced)
   396	            request += b"\r\n"
   397	        request += b"\r\n"
   398	        if content:                              # one chunk, exact segmentation
   399	            request += b"%x\r\n" % len(content)
   400	            request += content
   401	            request += b"\r\n"
   402	        request += b"0\r\n"
   403	        for name, value in trailer_pairs:
   404	            request += name
   405	            request += b": "
   406	            request += value
   407	            request += b"\r\n"
   408	        request += b"\r\n"
   409	
   410	    cache_key = [method.decode("latin-1"), scheme.decode("latin-1"),
   411	                 canonical.decode("latin-1"), path.decode("latin-1")]
   412	    return bytes(request), cache_key, origin
   413	
   414	
   415	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   416	# Scenario driver
   417	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   418	
   419	def bridge(scenario):
   420	    routes = scenario["routes"]
   421	    events = scenario["events"]
   422	
   423	    # Every distinct origin label gets a pipeline, used or not.
   424	    pipelines = {}
   425	    for label in routes.values():
   426	        if label not in pipelines:
   427	            pipelines[label] = bytearray()
   428	
   429	    # Buffer each observed stream, including one first seen in a terminal,
   430	    # DATA or unknown frame.  Unknown frames contribute nothing anywhere.
   431	    streams = {}
   432	    for index, event in enumerate(events):
   433	        sid = event["sid"]
   434	        kind = event["type"]
   435	        state = streams.get(sid)
   436	        if state is None:
   437	            state = streams[sid] = [[], None, None]
   438	        if kind == "headers":
   439	            state[0].append((HEADERS, event["fields"]))
   440	        elif kind == "data":
   441	            state[0].append((DATA, bytes.fromhex(event["hex"])))
   442	        elif kind == "fin":
   443	            state[1] = "fin"
   444	            state[2] = index
   445	        elif kind == "reset":
   446	            state[1] = "reset"
   447	            state[2] = index
   448	
   449	    def blank(sid, status):
   450	        return {"sid": sid, "status": status, "commit_at": None, "origin": None,
   451	                "offset": None, "length": 0, "cache_key": None}
   452	
   453	    records = {}
   454	    commits = []
   455	    for sid in sorted(streams):
   456	        frames, terminal, at = streams[sid]
   457	        if terminal == "reset":
   458	            records[sid] = blank(sid, "cancelled")   # contents never matter
   459	        elif terminal is None:
   460	            records[sid] = blank(sid, "incomplete")  # no terminal event seen
   461	        else:
   462	            commits.append((at, sid))
   463	
   464	    # Forwarded requests join their pipeline in FIN order, never stream-ID or
   465	    # first-HEADERS order; rejected streams contribute no bytes or offsets.
   466	    commits.sort()
   467	    for _at, sid in commits:
   468	        outcome = finalize(streams[sid][0], routes)
   469	        if outcome is None:
   470	            records[sid] = blank(sid, "rejected")    # atomic: no bytes at all
   471	            continue
   472	        request, cache_key, origin = outcome
   473	        pipeline = pipelines[origin]
   474	        record = blank(sid, "forwarded")
   475	        record["commit_at"] = _at
   476	        record["origin"] = origin
   477	        record["offset"] = len(pipeline)
   478	        record["length"] = len(request)
   479	        record["cache_key"] = cache_key
   480	        records[sid] = record
   481	        pipeline += request
   482	
   483	    return {"streams": [records[sid] for sid in sorted(records)],
   484	            "origins": {label: pipeline.hex()
   485	                        for label, pipeline in pipelines.items()}}
   486	
   487	
   488	def main():
   489	    scenario = json.load(sys.stdin)
   490	    sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(bridge(scenario), ensure_ascii=True))
   491	    sys.stdout.write("\n")
   492	
   493	
   494	if __name__ == "__main__":
   495	    main()
